BLOCK exact bf1f1a5360595ad3ad717a086390425a16253e77 over parent/base e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a.

Positive custody evidence: recovered ref exists in this repository; exact candidate touches 26 paths, all under docs-site and zero outside; diff-check is clean. bf1f1a5:docs-site tree bf1aa90bb33824b364963dd6860b8140f1e0b8c2 exactly equals prior blocked 39c745d:docs-site, so the work is durable and the review is byte-comparable.

Blocking findings:
1. The receipt is still forgeable. src/lib/provenance.ts accepts arbitrary DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION and uses it as sourceRevision, sourceBase, and visible build identity without proving it equals the checked-out source. The prior forty-zero mutation on this exact docs-site tree built successfully and published the false revision. Tree identity makes that runnable negative receipt applicable to this candidate.
2. The explicit owner gate remains absent. Exact-tree search finds zero GraphHsmm, RecallSignature, CandidateGenerator, or BirthdayInterview examples and no scientific output plot. The only SVG is the favicon; the only output artifact is the byte-verbatim plumbing proof. The site therefore still does not contain the accepted six-workflow spine with executable code, captured output, explanations, and meaningful reproducible plots.
3. Evidence links remain wrong: SurfaceAnalyzer is linked to core/.../surface.scala instead of atlas.scala; sourceLink uses GitHub blob semantics for docs/adr as though a directory were a blob; the module evidence says build.sbt dependency graph while linking only embed-core/README.md.
4. Candidate-row hygiene is unresolved. cand-163TSH remains pending and blocked for the identical docs-site tree; this proposal did not supersede it, leaving parallel rows for the same artifact.

Exact-candidate npm build was not run because these source-level and previously mutation-proven defects already block approval. Prior positive Astro verification on the identical docs-site tree is site-stack evidence only, not proof that bf1f1a5 emits truthful source links against its new base.

Required successor: retain the recovered infrastructure; make revision identity derived or checked rather than caller-asserted; repair evidence targets; implement the accepted public-API WOG program with captured output and interpretation, plus the six-workflow code/output/plot spine; explicitly supersede both docs candidates.
